response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(p.bats, '')) = '' THEN '(blank)' ELSE TRIM(p.bats) END AS bats_hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f LEFT JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY 1), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.bats_hand, h.cnt AS count, h.cnt * 1.0 / t.total_cnt AS share, h.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS above_avg FROM hand_counts h CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE h.cnt > t.avg_cnt;
